_doc: Market-folk Effects library (world-depth:market-folk). Know the Way Out is referenced from world-depth:thien_xu (new: false). Second Spring (set) was renamed Apricot Clinic's Spring in market-folk.items.json to keep item vs set rules distinct.

Apricot Clinic's Spring.rule: Apricot Clinic (Hạnh Hoa Y Cụ), 3 pieces: a poison or curse the Needles draw into you heals you over its duration instead of harming you, at half its strength.
Apricot Clinic's Spring.approx: Always sets tick_to_heal: 50 for Wood Poison ticks so Poison ticks heal at 50 % strength (status-curse conversion awaits non-ticking curse heal hooks).

Carried Array.rule: Loom of Letters Seal (Văn Cơ Ấn): a formation you have laid before in the same fight is laid again in half the time; once a fight, your array Field's duration is refreshed.
Carried Array.approx: Grants +100 % formation art speed after the first formation art fires (halving cooldown), and once a fight refreshes active stars_bow / walking_field / ring counters when an array art fires.

Change Expected.rule: Fair Weights (Công Xứng Song Bảo), 2 pieces: each time a foe strikes you, it owes: your next hit on it deals extra damage equal to a fifth of what it dealt you (once every 2 s per foe).
Change Expected.approx: Effect DSL has no cross-event raw HP bank independent of next hit amount; models this directly via return_damage share 0.20 (Physical) on damaging was_hit with a 2 s cooldown.

Even Failures Are Pills.rule: Vermilion and Azure (Đan Thanh Tam Bảo), 3 pieces: each pill you take in a fight lays two Fire stacks on the foe, and heals you 1 % for each Fire stack you hold on the foe; each pill after the third in a fight costs you 2 % of your health.
Even Failures Are Pills.approx: On pill_burned adds 2 Fire debuff stacks (6 s), heals 1 % per Fire debuff stack on the foe, and applies a ~2 % Chaos self_hit (c 0.4) past 3 pills in one fight (awaiting multi-pill combat support).

Ground Like Paint.rule: Vermilion-Azure Censer (Đan Thanh Lô): a pill taken in a fight works a second time at half strength three seconds later; once a fight, a pill that would fail gives half its effect instead.
Ground Like Paint.approx: Tracks pill_burned grade into paint_echo_g and pulses a half-strength Fire debuff + 2 % per grade heal 3 s later; a failed pill (event.failed >= 1) triggers an immediate half-strength Fire debuff + heal once per fight.

Hear the Flaw.rule: Listening Bronze Mirror (Thính Kim Kính): your first hit on the foe in a fight strikes against its lowest resistance.
Hear the Flaw.approx: Grants +150 resistance penetration (`pen`) until your first hit lands (`flaw_heard` cap 1) to model striking the foe's weakest defence angle.

Heavy Keel.rule: Sea-Crossing Anchor (Tế Hải Mao): while you are Composed, you cannot be delayed or moved.

Lose to Win.rule: The Losing Hand (Thua Thủ Song Bảo), 2 pieces: each crit that lands on you puts a coin in the vault, and the coins fall by one every 4 s; your next coin art spends them, gaining 10 % crit chance per coin and a buried ward worth 3 % of your health per coin.
Lose to Win.approx: Each vault coin runs a 4 s timer (`each_for: 4.0`); the next coin-tagged art spends all live coins for +10 % crit chance and a 3 % max-HP body shield per coin.

Paid Back.rule: Collected in Full (Thu Túc Song Bảo), 2 pieces: a foe carrying 5 of your Earth stacks is collected: its stacks cannot be cleansed, and each second it loses 1 % of its health and you heal that much.
Paid Back.approx: When foe.debuff.earth reaches 5, protects applied Earth debuffs from cleanse (`protect: {el: earth}`) and pulses a 0.25 c shield-piercing Chaos hit (~1 % equal-realm max HP) plus 1 % own HP heal each second while foe.debuff.earth >= 5.

Paid in Full.rule: Golden Valley Ledger Seal (Kim Cốc Trướng Ấn): a debuff you apply cannot be cleansed until half its duration has run.
Paid in Full.approx: Protects applied Earth and Metal debuff batches for their first 4.0 s (`protect {for_first: 4.0}`, half of standard 8 s batch duration).

Ride Out the Storm.rule: The Bào Hull (Bào Gia Thuyền Cụ), 3 pieces: while you are Composed, each second you regain 2 % of your linh lực and gain one Water buff stack; each stack makes you take 1 % less damage, and the stacks fall away one a second once you are Pressing.

Second Spring.rule: Second Spring Needles (Hồi Xuân Châm): once a fight, while you are below a quarter of your health, the next poison batch or curse placed on you lands at half strength.
Second Spring.approx: Once per fight when health drops below 25 %, cleanses 3 Wood poison stacks and 1 curse and grants +50 % status resistance for 5 s to model halving the incoming poison/curse.

The Array Comes With Me.rule: The Carried Array (Huề Trận Tam Bảo), 3 pieces: your diagram is open at fight start; while your array Field is up, each hit on you is answered once by your array's damage, at most once a second.
The Array Comes With Me.approx: Grants +20 % opening haste to bring your array Field up immediately, and while own.field_up >= 1 answers each incoming hit with a 0.4 c Earth-Physical strike (1 s cooldown).

The Books Balance.rule: Golden Valley Suite (Kim Cốc Tam Bảo), 3 pieces: while all three are worn, a debuff you applied that is cleansed returns a quarter of its remaining damage to the one who cleansed it.
The Books Balance.approx: Deals 0.25 c shield-piercing Chaos damage per cleansed debuff stack when the foe cleanses your debuffs.

The Losing Hand.rule: Ring of the Losing Hand (Thua Thủ Hoàn): the first time each fight a critical hit lands on you, your next three hits cannot miss.

The Way In.rule: Peach Spring Painting (Đào Nguyên Đồ): on an opening night of Đào Nguyên Cảnh, whoever unrolls the painting beside the forest stream on the cape is shown the way in. Whoever goes in comes out without the memory of the road.
The Way In.not_run: out-of-fight secret-realm entry key rule (Đào Nguyên Cảnh): no part in a combat duel

Unstamped.rule: Scorched Cloud Seal (Tiêu Vân Ấn): talismans painted under this seal cost a third less to paint, and one in ten fails.
Unstamped.approx: Cuts talisman art linh lực cost by 33.3 % (`cost_red: 0.333`) and causes every tenth talisman art to misfire (`dmg_more: -1.0`).
